paragraphs.text: Acapistan or Acapiston is a region likely on the continent Otaria on Dominaria , somewhere south of Tamingazin .

Not much is known of Acapistan, and specifically its exact location is unclear, but appears to be located south of Tamingazin , beyond Suderbod , which places it somewhere on or near Otaria . It is a warm, tropical area of deserts and jungles where dark-skinned humans live and where golden rings, bracelets, and other jewelry are made.

Acapistan's spelling is inconsistent; it is referred to as Acapistan three times and Acapiston twice. This had led to confusion whether Acapiston and Acapistan may be two separate places with almost identical names, or simply spelling errors.
